How it works on the day

Good to know. Bottled water is on board and it is the only complimentary amenity; everything else is an add-on you choose at checkout.

  • Where we meet you: One pickup address for the whole group and one phone we call — the best man, not the group chat. Put every stop on the reservation before the night starts; stops on an hourly charter cost nothing, so list them all.
  • Luggage: Golf bags, coolers and overnight bags all compete for the same floor. Say what is coming when you request the quote and we confirm the fit in writing rather than at the curb. The Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is rated for up to 30 bags.
  • What we can and cannot do: Hourly charters start at four hours. The vehicle stays with your group for the whole booked window, so the clock runs from pickup to the last drop-off, not per stop. Anything the online quote cannot price — an unusual route, a multi-vehicle movement, a vehicle we hold for request only — goes to the reservations desk and comes back as a written quote before any card is charged.
  • What it costs: 7 hours in the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax): the hour ladder gives you 1 free hour, so you pay for 6: 6 × $175 = $1,050. Add 8% Arizona tax; there is no booking fee and no fuel fee. How the rest settles depends on how you pay: a 50% deposit holds the date and the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk is due before the ride.

Frequently asked questions

How much does bachelor party transportation cost in Scottsdale?

Pricing is calculated from the selected vehicle, duration, date, and route. A longer golf-to-dinner itinerary will be priced differently from a short Old Town evening.

Can you store golf clubs on the sprinter van?

Golf-bag capacity varies by vehicle and passenger count. Share the exact number of players, club bags, and other luggage so the team can confirm fit.

What's the best bachelor party itinerary in Scottsdale?

A common structure is golf, an afternoon activity, dinner, and Old Town. Confirm the tee time and venue reservations first, then sequence the transportation route around them.

How late can you drive us?

Late-night return times are confirmed with the booking. Venue hours and alcohol service follow current Arizona law and venue policy.

Can we bring our own drinks?

Alcohol may be permitted for passengers 21+ only when lawful, approved for the selected vehicle, and stated in the written booking terms.
